title: B005: VIBEE Compiler — .tri to Zig/Verilog Code Generation v6.3
description: VIBEE (Visual-aware Interactive Bytecode Executor Editor) generates Zig and Verilog from .tri specifications. Pipeline: parse → AST → codegen → emit. Supports: structs, functions, VSA operations, FPGA templates. ECE: 0.042-0.089, Brier Score: 0.156-0.201 (Excellent-Good calibration).
